nodes.text: #HMPV spreads through respiratory droplets, just like influenza. While common symptoms (cough, sore throat,  runny nose) tend to resolve in a few days, it's important to keep an eye on people at greater risk—like infants, the elderly, and people with underlying health conditions. https://t.co/CjKHREX76K
